The '''Emergency Pack''' was a portable and personal [[Distress beacon/Legends|emergency beacon]] manufactured by [[Chedak Communications]]. About the size of two [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]], the Emergency Pack contained a burst transmitter with a range of four [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] and a battery that could last for two hundred and fifty [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]].<ref name="PSG" />
